name: buckley-large-18
original:
fix(tool): handle mixed batch and top-level edits (#229)

fix(tool): handle mixed batch and top-level edits
fix(tool): reject incomplete top-level replace-all edits
- Allow mixed batch and top-level edits when the top-level replacement duplicates or extends the batch.
- Return actionable retry guidance for incomplete mixed edit arguments and empty batches.
- Cover mixed-edit behavior and changed-argument retries to prevent false repeat detection.

- Ignore a lone `replace_all:false` in mixed edits because it is the default and has no effect.
- Reject `replace_all:true` without top-level replacement strings to prevent silently incomplete edits.
